checked_classes: Missed goal coverage — bounded characterization, readiness tracing, timing attribution, competing explanations, diagnosis and remediation each have explicit gaps and progress status.

Unsupported or contradictory codebase claims — supplied source excerpts support the full-table read, embedding deserialization, dependency labels, presence-only memory check and readiness timeout eligibility; the file tree contains the remaining cited implementation and specification files, with no packet contradiction.
Vague findings — diagnostic gaps identify concrete unknowns, relevant implementation locations and the evidence needed to distinguish candidate explanations.
Goals restated as findings — the assessment connects goals to historical observations and source behavior, explicitly separating confirmed mechanisms from unmeasured latency contributions.
Scope and phase violations — current diagnostics remain deferred until a written plan; the assessment reports no product tests, service requests, fixes, restarts or prohibited mutations.

Premature causal conclusions — CLI setup costs, namespace uncertainty, installed identity and missing correlated timings are explicit limitations; neither database slowness nor full-table retrieval is asserted as the established root cause.
